All 15,361 edges per map agreed with the claimed SHA-256 digests; precisely 2,774 edges differ. Independent complete successor traversal reproduced staged basins (5092,2,10267) with period 40 and U basins (15236,8,117) with period 5, and preperiod maxima 83/109. This is exhaustive evidence for these finite maps, not real logistic dynamics or arbitrary hardware expression semantics.
